name: The ladder of goals in Caitanya's dialogue with Rāmānanda Rāya (CC 2.8)

stages.name: varṇāśrama-dharma
stages.description: Worship of Viṣṇu through one's social duties — called 'external'.

stages.name: karmārpaṇa
stages.description: Offering the fruits of all action to Kṛṣṇa — 'external'.

stages.name: svadharma-tyāga
stages.description: Abandoning social duty for refuge in Kṛṣṇa — 'external'.

stages.name: jñāna-miśrā bhakti
stages.description: Devotion still aimed at knowledge — 'external'.

stages.name: jñāna-śūnyā bhakti
stages.description: Giving up the effort for knowledge and living by hearing (BhP 10.14.3) — 'this is so; go further'.

stages.name: prema-bhakti
stages.description: Love of God as the essence of all goals.

stages.name: kānta-prema
stages.description: The love of the gopīs, highest among the relationships.

stages.name: rādhā-prema
stages.description: Rādhā's love as the crown of all.

stages.name: prema-vilāsa-vivarta
stages.description: The state where lover and beloved lose the sense of separateness, expressed in Rāmānanda's song; Caitanya closes Rāmānanda's mouth.

notes: Order and wording as recalled from CC 2.8 (c. vv. 57–195); the ladder is a dialogue, not a practice sequence; B-bands are interpretive.

name: The stages of love from prema to mahābhāva (Ujjvalanīlamaṇi)

stages.name: prema
stages.description: Love that never breaks despite causes for breaking.

stages.name: sneha
stages.description: Love that melts the heart and illumines it.

stages.name: māna
stages.description: Love that conceals itself in crookedness.

stages.name: praṇaya
stages.description: Love free of reverence, feeling oneness.

stages.name: rāga
stages.description: Sorrow becomes happiness for the beloved.

stages.name: anurāga
stages.description: The beloved ever fresh.

stages.name: bhāva / mahābhāva
stages.description: Found only in the gopīs; rūḍha and adhirūḍha, the latter with modana and (in Rādhā alone) mādana.

notes: All stages lie within the goal (prema); banded B7 as gradations of the attained goal. Kṛṣṇadāsa compares them to the stages of refining sugar-cane (CC 2.23; verse to verify).

name: Viśvanātha's elaboration of the stages from faith to love (Mādhuryakādambinī)

stages.name: śraddhā
stages.description: Faith arising from association with devotees and scripture.

stages.name: bhajana-kriyā (unsteady)
stages.description: Unsteady practice passes through six phases: utsāhamayī, ghana-taralā, vyūḍha-vikalpā, viṣaya-saṅgarā, niyamākṣamā, taraṅga-raṅgiṇī.

stages.name: anartha-nivṛtti
stages.description: Removal of the four kinds of anartha.

stages.name: niṣṭhā
stages.description: Freedom from sleepiness, distraction, incapacity, residual impurity and relish of other pleasures.

stages.name: ruci
stages.description: Taste for hearing, chanting and the rest for their own sake.

stages.name: āsakti
stages.description: Attachment to the Lord himself.

stages.name: bhāva
stages.description: The sprouting of love; visions and sphūrti of the Lord's play.

stages.name: prema
stages.description: Love, with direct experience of the Lord.

notes: Elaborates Rūpa's map (pth:rupa-gosvami-bhakti-stages, owned by U51). Chapter numbers approximate.

stages.name: bīja
stages.description: The seed of love given by grace (through the brahmasambandha).

stages.name: dṛḍhatā
stages.description: Made firm by renunciation, hearing and singing while remaining at home in service.

stages.name: prema / sneha
stages.description: Love that destroys attachment to other things.

stages.name: āsakti
stages.description: Attachment that makes the home distasteful.

stages.name: vyasana
stages.description: Absorption in Kṛṣṇa such that one cannot live without him; one is then fulfilled.
